#: Carries the Responses `reasoning` items (encrypted_content kept, OUTPUT-only fields
#: dropped -- see _REASONING_INPUT_FIELDS) on an assistant transcript entry, for next-turn
#: replay. Stripped before the Chat wire.
#: Carries a tool call's Responses `function_call` item id, for next-turn replay.
#: Stripped before the Chat wire.
#: With `store=False` the endpoint keeps no per-turn state; encrypted reasoning replays it.
#: A stored reasoning item is replayed as an INPUT item, which accepts only these fields.
#: A gateway's own OUTPUT item (what a reasoning item's model_dump() actually returns) also
#: carries OUTPUT-only fields such as `status`; replaying one of those back verbatim is
#: rejected as an unknown input parameter, so only this allowlist is ever stored or replayed.
# Explicit: the Responses API attempts strict mode when this is omitted.
# A plain copy, not a re-filter: _encrypted_reasoning_items() already stored each item
# allowlisted to _REASONING_INPUT_FIELDS, so there is nothing OUTPUT-only left to drop here.
# Allowlist by construction: only id/function.name/function.arguments/the replay item id
# are ever read off *tool_call*, so an OUTPUT-only field such as `status` never reaches
# this item either, the same discipline _encrypted_reasoning_items() applies.
# `store=False`: no per-turn server state, so encrypted reasoning does the replay.
# Never 'none' on the wire here: a gateway that reasons on Responses must stay silenced-off
# by OMITTING the field (its own default), not by this route muting it the Chat way.
# A failed call with no error body is still a failure: nothing downstream must read
# it as a normal, empty "stop" the way Chat Completions can never shape a reply.
# Allowlist by construction: only call_id/name/arguments/id are ever read off *item*, so an
# OUTPUT-only field such as `status` never reaches the stored tool call or its replay.
